title: Roswell witnesses describe threats made in 1947

tellings.quote: threats they'll be picking your bones out of the desert not they I had guys tell me this is what was said at the time

plain: In 1947 in Roswell, New Mexico, where a crashed object was said to have been recovered, local people were threatened to keep quiet, told that "they'll be picking your bones out of the desert." James Fox, a UFO investigator and filmmaker, tells Michels that men who were there told him this was what had been said to them at the time. If true, it would mean the military forced silence about what came down.
